description.en: Southern Lebanon up to the Beirut area after the June 1982 invasion; withdrawals in stages to 1985.
description.ar: جنوب لبنان حتى منطقة بيروت بعد الغزو في حزيران/يونيو 1982؛ انسحابات على مراحل حتى 1985.
description.he: דרום לבנון עד אזור ביירות לאחר הפלישה ביוני 1982; נסיגות בשלבים עד 1985.

sources.quote: For three years, UNIFIL remained behind the Israeli lines
On 6 June 1982, however, the Israeli government used the pretext of the attempted assassination in London of the Israeli ambassador by an anti-PLO Palestinian group to launch an invasion of Lebanon.
The Israelis quickly encircled West Beirut, site of the PLO’s headquarters, and laid siege to that part of the city throughout the summer.
Subsequently, however, the mission was enlarged and the capture of Beirut signalled the transition to a long drawn-out war.

description.en: The 'security zone' strip along the border held by the IDF and the South Lebanon Army.
description.ar: شريط 'المنطقة الأمنية' على طول الحدود الذي يحتله الجيش الإسرائيلي وجيش لبنان الجنوبي.
description.he: רצועת “רצועת הביטחון” לאורך הגבול שהחזיקו צה״ל וצבא דרום לבנון.

sources.quote: it retained control of an area in southern Lebanon
A token force was left behind, to help the citizens of south Lebanon to patrol the Security Zone - a narrow strip of territory adjacent to Israel's border
sources.note: After the national unity government of 1984 decided to 'withdraw forthwith from Lebanon'. Israeli government narrative (Netanel Lorch), written while the zone still existed.

sources.quote: led to an Israeli occupation of parts of Southern Lebanon that lasted until 2000.
the Government will treat the inhabitants of the formerly occupied zone as equal citizens of Lebanon

notes.en: Depth of the zone not quantified in an opened source.
notes.ar: لم يُحدَّد عمق المنطقة كميًا في مصدر مفتوح.
notes.he: עומק האזור לא הוערך כמותית במקור שנפתח.
